{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows consistent negative signals (e.g., multiple -0.20 or -1.00 entries).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 7-14 day average, reduce by 5-15% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment shows strong negative momentum (e.g., 3+ consecutive negative sentiment values).",
    "Avoid overreacting to recent highs: if model forecast is >10% above true outcome for 2+ consecutive days, apply a 10-20% downward correction.",
    "When sentiment is positive but price is trending down, reduce forecast slope to avoid premature reversal.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, especially after a spike, apply a 5-10% downward adjustment to next forecast.",
    "For sentiment history with mixed signals (e.g., 0.00/0.33/1.00), use a weighted average of recent 5-day true values to anchor forecast."
  ]
}
